title_en: How probate works in {state} after a parent dies
title_es: Cómo funciona el proceso sucesorio en {state_es} después de que muere un padre o una madre
search_intent_en: how to open an estate in {state}
search_intent_es: cómo funciona el proceso sucesorio en {state_es}

facts.claim_en: In Alaska, informal probate lets the personal representative transfer a person's property to the people who should receive it with minimal court supervision.
facts.claim_es: En Alaska, la sucesión informal permite que el representante personal transfiera los bienes de la persona fallecida a quienes deben recibirlos con poca supervisión del tribunal.
facts.quote: Informal probate is a court process that allows the Personal Representative to transfer the property of a person who died to the persons who are supposed to receive it with minimal court supervision.

facts.claim_en: An Alaska informal probate includes notifying creditors and beneficiaries or heirs.
facts.claim_es: Una sucesión informal en Alaska incluye avisar a los acreedores y a los beneficiarios o herederos.
facts.quote: Notifying creditors and beneficiaries or heirs.

facts.claim_en: Alaska's court suggests asking for 3 to 5 extra certified copies of the Letters, because companies will ask to see them when you transfer property.
facts.claim_es: El tribunal de Alaska sugiere pedir de 3 a 5 copias certificadas adicionales de las cartas (Letters), porque las empresas pedirán verlas al transferir bienes.
facts.quote: It is a good idea to ask for 3 to 5 extra certified copies of the Letters since you will need to show the Letters to companies when you transfer property owned by the person who died.

facts.claim_en: In California, you open probate by going to court and asking a judge to appoint a personal representative.
facts.claim_es: En California, la sucesión se abre acudiendo al tribunal y pidiendo a un juez que nombre a un representante personal.
facts.quote: To start a probate case (called opening probate), you go to court and ask a judge to appoint a personal representative.

facts.claim_en: In California, anyone who finds an original will must deliver it to the court.
facts.claim_es: En California, quien encuentre un testamento original debe entregarlo al tribunal.
facts.quote: If you find an original will, you must deliver it to the court.

facts.claim_en: In California, the personal representative collects the property, pays the bills, and distributes what is left to the people legally entitled to it.
facts.claim_es: En California, el representante personal reúne los bienes, paga las deudas y reparte lo que queda entre las personas con derecho legal a recibirlo.
facts.quote: The personal representative collects all the property of the person that died, pays their bills, and then distributes any remaining property to the people with a legal right to receive the property

facts.claim_en: In California, if the person named in the will cannot serve or there is no will, an order of priority decides who may be appointed.
facts.claim_es: En California, si la persona nombrada en el testamento no puede actuar o no hay testamento, un orden de prioridad decide a quién se puede nombrar.
facts.quote: If the person named in the will cannot act or there is no will, then there's an order of priority for who may be appointed a personal representative.

facts.claim_en: In DC, after a Petition for Probate is filed, the Probate Division appoints a personal representative.
facts.claim_es: En DC, después de presentarse una petición de sucesión, la División Testamentaria nombra a un representante personal.
facts.quote: After a Petition for Probate of the decedent's estate is filed, the Probate Division will appoint a Personal Representative

facts.claim_en: DC treats an estate as a small estate when the person had property worth $80,000 or less.
facts.claim_es: DC considera herencia pequeña la de una persona con bienes por $80,000 o menos.
facts.quote: Small Estates For someone who had property worth $80,000 or less.

facts.claim_en: In DC, a large estate case is for someone who owned real estate in DC or had more than $80,000 in property.
facts.claim_es: En DC, el caso de herencia grande es para quien tenía bienes inmuebles en DC o más de $80,000 en bienes.
facts.quote: owned real estate in DC or had more than $80,000 in property

facts.claim_en: To open an estate in North Carolina, bring the will (if any), a certified death certificate, an application with a preliminary inventory, and a $120 filing fee.
facts.claim_es: Para abrir una herencia en Carolina del Norte, lleve el testamento (si existe), un acta de defunción certificada, una solicitud con un inventario preliminar y una tarifa de $120.
facts.quote: You should bring: (1) the will if there was one, (2) a certified death certificate, (3) an application and preliminary inventory of the decedent's property; and (4) a $120 filing fee.

facts.claim_en: In North Carolina, an executor named in a valid will has the highest priority to receive letters.
facts.claim_es: En Carolina del Norte, el albacea nombrado en un testamento válido tiene la mayor prioridad para recibir las cartas.
facts.quote: If there is a valid will, an executor named in the will has the highest priority to receive letters.

facts.claim_en: In North Carolina, out-of-state executors generally must post a bond to protect creditors and heirs.
facts.claim_es: En Carolina del Norte, los albaceas de otro estado normalmente deben pagar una fianza para proteger a los acreedores y herederos.
facts.quote: Out-of-state executors generally must pay a bond to the court to protect creditors and heirs from potential losses.

facts.claim_en: Vermont has 14 probate division judges, elected for four-year terms.
facts.claim_es: Vermont tiene 14 jueces de la división testamentaria, elegidos por períodos de cuatro años.
facts.quote: There are 14 probate division judges who are elected for four-year terms.

facts.claim_en: In Vermont, the probate division examines whether a will is legally valid.
facts.claim_es: En Vermont, la división testamentaria examina si un testamento es legalmente válido.
facts.quote: The probate division examines the legality of a will.

facts.claim_en: Vermont's probate division oversees the estate to make sure the executor or administrator does the job correctly and honors the person's final wishes.
facts.claim_es: La división testamentaria de Vermont supervisa la herencia para que el albacea o administrador cumpla bien sus funciones y respete la última voluntad.
facts.quote: It then oversees the administration of the estate to ensure that the executor or administrator correctly performs their duties, follows laws, and honors final wishes.

facts.claim_en: In Texas probate, with court approval the will is validated, debts are paid, and the rest of the property passes to the heirs.
facts.claim_es: En la sucesión en Texas, con aprobación del tribunal se valida el testamento, se pagan las deudas y el resto de los bienes pasa a los herederos.
facts.quote: With court approval, the will is validated, the debts are paid, and the rest of the property passes to the heirs.

facts.claim_en: In a Texas estate administration, the court appoints a specific person to manage the whole process.
facts.claim_es: En una administración de herencia en Texas, el tribunal nombra a una persona específica para manejar todo el proceso.
facts.quote: In administration, the court appoints a specific person to manage the whole process.

facts.claim_en: In Texas, nonprobate property passes directly to the beneficiaries without court approval.
facts.claim_es: En Texas, los bienes no sujetos a sucesión pasan directamente a los beneficiarios sin aprobación del tribunal.
facts.quote: Nonprobate property passes directly to the beneficiaries without court approval.

facts.claim_en: In Texas, after 15 months any party in the probate case can ask the executor for a detailed accounting.
facts.claim_es: En Texas, después de 15 meses cualquier parte del caso de sucesión puede pedir al albacea un informe de cuentas detallado.
facts.quote: After 15 months, any party involved in the probate proceedings can ask the executor for a detailed accounting report.

facts.claim_en: In New Hampshire, estates that need a published notice pay a $55 publication fee (since December 28, 2021).
facts.claim_es: En Nuevo Hampshire, las herencias que requieren un aviso publicado pagan una tarifa de publicación de $55 (desde el 28 de diciembre de 2021).
facts.source_name: New Hampshire Judicial Branch, Probate Division
facts.quote: For estates requiring a publication fee, the fee will be $55 starting on December 28, 2021.

facts.claim_en: New Hampshire's courts publish a booklet, Administering an Estate, for estates filed in the probate division.
facts.claim_es: Los tribunales de Nuevo Hampshire publican un folleto, Administering an Estate, para las herencias presentadas en la división testamentaria.
facts.source_name: New Hampshire Judicial Branch, Probate Division
facts.quote: please refer to this booklet Administering an Estate

facts.claim_en: New Hampshire's Administering an Estate booklet guides people serving as fiduciary of an estate.
facts.claim_es: El folleto Administering an Estate de Nuevo Hampshire orienta a quienes actúan como fiduciarios de una herencia.
facts.source_name: New Hampshire Judicial Branch, Probate Division
facts.quote: It provides a guide to serving as a fiduciary of an estate.

facts.claim_en: In Arizona, probate is generally opened in the county where the person lived (was domiciled) at death.
facts.claim_es: En Arizona, la sucesión normalmente se abre en el condado donde la persona tenía su domicilio al morir.
facts.quote: In the county where the decedent had his domicile at the time of his death.

facts.claim_en: If the person did not live in Arizona, probate can be opened in any Arizona county where they had property.
facts.claim_es: Si la persona no vivía en Arizona, la sucesión se puede abrir en cualquier condado de Arizona donde tenía bienes.
facts.quote: If the decedent was not domiciled in this state, in any county where property of the decedent was located at the time of his death.

facts.claim_en: Arizona law sets an ultimate time limit for starting probate and appointment proceedings.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Arizona fija un plazo máximo para iniciar procesos sucesorios y de nombramiento.
facts.quote: Probate, testacy and appointment proceedings; ultimate time limit

facts.claim_en: In Maine, probate is generally opened in the county where the person was domiciled at death.
facts.claim_es: En Maine, la sucesión normalmente se abre en el condado donde la persona tenía su domicilio al morir.
facts.quote: In the county where the decedent was domiciled at the time of death

facts.claim_en: If the person did not live in Maine, probate can be opened in any Maine county where they had property.
facts.claim_es: Si la persona no vivía en Maine, la sucesión se puede abrir en cualquier condado de Maine donde tenía bienes.
facts.quote: If the decedent was not domiciled in this State, in any county where property of the decedent was located at the time of the decedent's death.

facts.claim_en: In Maine, most probate and appointment proceedings may not be started more than 3 years after the death, with some exceptions.
facts.claim_es: En Maine, la mayoría de los procesos sucesorios y de nombramiento no se pueden iniciar más de 3 años después de la muerte, con algunas excepciones.
facts.quote: may not be commenced more than 3 years after the decede

facts.claim_en: In Minnesota, probate is generally opened in the county where the person was domiciled at death.
facts.claim_es: En Minnesota, la sucesión normalmente se abre en el condado del domicilio de la persona al morir.
facts.quote: in the county of the decedent's domicile at the time of death

facts.claim_en: If the person did not live in Minnesota, probate can be opened in any Minnesota county where they had property.
facts.claim_es: Si la persona no vivía en Minnesota, la sucesión se puede abrir en cualquier condado de Minnesota donde tenía bienes.
facts.quote: if the decedent was not domiciled in this state, in any county where property of the decedent was located at the time of death

facts.claim_en: In Minnesota, probate for an absent or missing person may be brought within three years after their death is established.
facts.claim_es: En Minnesota, la sucesión de una persona ausente o desaparecida se puede iniciar dentro de tres años después de establecerse su muerte.
facts.quote: at any time within three years after the death of the absentee

facts.claim_en: In South Dakota, probate is generally opened in the county where the person was domiciled at death.
facts.claim_es: En Dakota del Sur, la sucesión normalmente se abre en el condado donde la persona tenía su domicilio al morir.
facts.quote: In the county where the decedent was domiciled at the time of death

facts.claim_en: If the person did not live in South Dakota, probate can be opened in any South Dakota county where they had property.
facts.claim_es: Si la persona no vivía en Dakota del Sur, la sucesión se puede abrir en cualquier condado de Dakota del Sur donde tenía bienes.
facts.quote: If the decedent was not domiciled in this state, in any county where property of the decedent was located at the time of death.

facts.claim_en: In South Dakota, most probate and appointment proceedings cannot be started more than three years after the death, with some exceptions.
facts.claim_es: En Dakota del Sur, la mayoría de los procesos sucesorios y de nombramiento no se pueden iniciar más de tres años después de la muerte, con algunas excepciones.
facts.quote: may be commenced more than three years after the decede

facts.claim_en: In Massachusetts, probate is generally filed in the county where the person was domiciled at death.
facts.claim_es: En Massachusetts, la sucesión normalmente se presenta en el condado donde la persona tenía su domicilio al morir.
facts.quote: in the county where the decedent was domiciled at the time of death

facts.claim_en: If the person did not live in Massachusetts, probate can be filed in any county where they had property.
facts.claim_es: Si la persona no vivía en Massachusetts, la sucesión se puede presentar en cualquier condado donde tenía bienes.
facts.quote: if the decedent was not domiciled in the commonwealth, in any county where property of the decedent was located at the time of death

facts.claim_en: In Massachusetts, whoever holds a will must deliver it within thirty days after learning of the death to someone who can get it probated.
facts.claim_es: En Massachusetts, quien tenga un testamento debe entregarlo dentro de treinta días después de saber de la muerte a alguien que pueda tramitar su validación.
facts.quote: a person having custody of a will of the testator shall deliver it within thirty days after notice of the death to a person able to secure its probate

facts.claim_en: In Nebraska, probate is generally opened in the county where the person was domiciled at death.
facts.claim_es: En Nebraska, la sucesión normalmente se abre en el condado donde la persona tenía su domicilio al morir.
facts.quote: in the county where the decedent had his domicile at the time of his death

facts.claim_en: If the person did not live in Nebraska, probate can be opened in any Nebraska county where they had property.
facts.claim_es: Si la persona no vivía en Nebraska, la sucesión se puede abrir en cualquier condado de Nebraska donde tenía bienes.
facts.quote: if the decedent was not domiciled in this state, in any county where property of the decedent was located at the time of his death

facts.claim_en: In Nebraska, probate for a missing person who has a conservator can be brought within a three-year window set by law.
facts.claim_es: En Nebraska, la sucesión de una persona desaparecida que tiene un curador se puede iniciar dentro de un plazo de tres años fijado por la ley.
facts.quote: may be maintained in relation to the estate of an absent, disappeared, or missing person for whose estate a conservator has been appointed, at any time within three year

facts.claim_en: In North Dakota, probate is generally opened in the county where the person was domiciled at death.
facts.claim_es: En Dakota del Norte, la sucesión normalmente se abre en el condado donde la persona tenía su domicilio al morir.
facts.quote: In the county where the decedent was domiciled at the time of death.

facts.claim_en: If the person did not live in North Dakota, probate can be opened in any North Dakota county where they had property.
facts.claim_es: Si la persona no vivía en Dakota del Norte, la sucesión se puede abrir en cualquier condado de Dakota del Norte donde tenía bienes.
facts.quote: If the decedent was not domiciled in this state, in any county where property of the decedent was located at the time of death.

facts.claim_en: In North Dakota, most probate and appointment proceedings cannot be started more than three years after the death, with some exceptions.
facts.claim_es: En Dakota del Norte, la mayoría de los procesos sucesorios y de nombramiento no se pueden iniciar más de tres años después de la muerte, con algunas excepciones.
facts.quote: may be commenced more than three years after the decede

facts.claim_en: In Wisconsin, anyone holding a will must file it in the proper court, or deliver it, within 30 days after learning of the death.
facts.claim_es: En Wisconsin, quien tenga un testamento debe presentarlo en el tribunal correspondiente, o entregarlo, dentro de 30 días después de saber de la muerte.
facts.quote: having the custody of any will shall, within 30 days after he or she has knowledge of the death of the testator, file the will in the proper court

facts.claim_en: In Wisconsin, a person named as personal representative must act on the will within 30 days after learning of the naming and the death.
facts.claim_es: En Wisconsin, la persona nombrada como representante personal debe actuar con el testamento dentro de 30 días después de saber del nombramiento y la muerte.
facts.quote: Any person named in a will to act as personal representative shall, within 30 days after he or she has knowledge that he or she is named

facts.claim_en: In Wisconsin, if no one petitions within 30 days after the death, a guardian or creditor of the person may petition for administration.
facts.claim_es: En Wisconsin, si nadie lo pide dentro de 30 días después de la muerte, un tutor o acreedor de la persona puede pedir la administración.
facts.quote: has petitioned within 30 days after the death of the decedent, petition for administration may be made by any person who was guardian of the decedent
